messages:
maria_ops: Heads-up: we need to rebalance H100v3 capacity in eu-west-1 (AMS) due to a firmware hotfix that landed this morning. This will run in a short window tomorrow and will temporarily shift some reserved pools and reduce burstable inventory starting 2026-04-01T14:00Z. Notifying ops & support now. @devon_runtime @sre_tim

devon_runtime: Thanks — what's the expected customer impact?

maria_ops: Target window 14:00-15:00 UTC. No rolling restarts of customer VMs, but we will drain 4 nodes across two racks; small-inference latency (<128 tokens) may see +20-50ms for 5-15m during drains.

sre_tim: We'll post a live readout in #eng-oncall and enable autoscale fallback to a10g_small pools for sensitive routes.

sales_elaine: Will Dedicated customers with guaranteed capacity be affected? We had a couple of pre-sold H100v3 pools.

maria_ops: Reserved capacity remains for the vast majority of commitments. A very small subset (pool-id: dp-ams-h100v3-17) will be moved and impacted customers were emailed earlier today. Support runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/ams-h100v3-rebalance (internal).

support_bot: [automated] Notifying customers in impacted accounts group: 23 accounts. ETA notifications sent.

devon_runtime: Any action required for model pinning? Some SDKs pin to exact minor revision tags.

maria_ops: If you pin to exact minor revision (h100v3-2026-03-27), please move to h100v3-latest or use model alias. Example curl to update pinning:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/pin \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
 -d '{"model":"h100v3-2026-03-27","alias":"h100v3-latest"}'
```

devon_runtime: Got it, we'll add a runtime rule to prefer eu-west-2 for large batches during the window.

oncall-sre: Monitoring plan: p95/p99 latency and token throughput. We will open an incident if p99 increases >100ms for >10m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/ops/ams-h100v3 (internal).

maria_ops: Ops note: burst queue size limited to 8k tokens/sec during the window. Temporary policy: routes with 'burst-allowed' = false will be deprioritized. Use fallback policy \"cost-optimized\" for sustained throughput if needed.

support_agent_jake: Support standby assigned 13:45-16:00 UTC. I have canned replies ready for support tickets.

sales_elaine: Posting a brief notice in the customer-status channel and flagging enterprise customers that were on the impacted pool.

sre_tim: +1, onshift and will keep watch.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: h100v3-firmware-hotfix -> 2026-04-01T14:05Z (drain + reprovision).

maria_ops: After the window we'll run validation jobs: regen perf profiles, run smoke tests for inference latency, and run a small evaluation suite for quality regressions. If you see anomalies ping me directly. :eyes: :heart:

devon_runtime: Thanks — updating routing rules now and will post the updated config snippet in #eng-runtime.

support_agent_jake: If support sees any customer-side regressions, escalate to #incidents and tag @maria_ops.

maria_ops: Closing the loop here. We'll post a short memo in #announcements after the window with final capacity numbers and any follow-ups. If anything unexpected happens we'll produce a post-incident summary.
